change: rules: `extinction` removed (losing every piece no longer loses).

proof.text: White (the horde of pawns) has no royal piece and can never get one: `rules.promotion` targets Q, R, B, N, none royal, and there are no drops. With `rules.extinction` gone, the only ending with a loser is checkmate (`rules.win`), which needs a royal piece. `rules.stalemate` is a draw. So no position is a White loss: a White side with no pieces left has no move, which is stalemate, a draw. White is not claimed to win.
